kurzbeschreibung: Kitzbühel – the legendary sports town in Tirol, famous for the Hahnenkamm-Rennen and surrounded by the Kitzbüheler Alpen.
beschreibung: Kitzbühel is one of the world’s most famous ski resorts. Every January, the best racers compete on the „Hahnenkamm“ track—the steepest and most demanding downhill in the Ski World Cup. Yet Kitzbühel is so much more than winter sports: its medieval old town with pastel-colored houses and narrow alleys, the Schwarzer See, and the Kitzbüheler Horn make the region a year-round destination. In summer, over 1,000 km of hiking trails, the Panoramaweg „Kitzbühel Alps Trail“, and the Kitzbühel-Schwarzsee Golf Club offer premium sports.
tipps: The legendary Hahnenkamm Streif downhill run can be hiked on foot during the summer – a thrilling adventure!
The Kitzbühel Advent market is widely considered one of the most charming Christmas markets in Tyrol.
The Bichlalm alpine inn is an insider tip for viewing unforgettable sunsets over the Kitzbüheler Horn.
empfehlungen: Definitely: Stroll through the Altstadt of Kitzbühel, visit the Museum Kitzbühel with exhibits on the Hahnenkamm race, and end your day in the Hinterstadt with a glass of Tiroler wine.
umgebung: The Kitzbüheler Alpen stretch between the Zillertal and Saalbach-Hinterglemm in Salzburg. Neighboring regions include the Wilder Kaiser (east), Brixental (west), and Pillerseetal (south). Nearest major city: Innsbruck (approx. 100 km away).
